name: go-webauthn-chrome-on-mac-2018-credential-in-use
authenticator: Chrome on Mac (its own Touch ID authenticator) of 2018
client: Chrome of 2018, or a browser of that time; judged by the members of the client data and their order: challenge, new_keys_may_be_added_here, origin, type

use.refusal: a credential in the authenticator data of a use
use.why: The authenticator data of this use has the AT flag and carries the credential again, as Chrome's first Touch ID authenticator did in 2018. WebAuthn Level 3, section 6.1: for assertion signatures the AT flag MUST NOT be set and the attestedCredentialData MUST NOT be included. Chrome stopped long ago; the uses captured from Chrome on Mac since have no credential. go-webauthn, where this comes from, accepts it.
